summary: Ares Frontier is a space strategy game set on Mars, where players lead an expedition to build and protect a new settlement. Players explore unknown sectors, collect resources, establish outposts, and develop new technologies while competing with rival factions. The goal is to secure the Martian frontier before the countdown reaches zero.
details:
Ares Frontier is a space strategy game where players build and protect a settlement on Mars. Players explore new areas, collect resources, build outposts, and research technologies while competing with rival factions.

The project helps develop problem-solving, planning, and decision-making skills while making space exploration fun and interesting.

We developed the game using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Three.js. Our main goal was to create an enjoyable and challenging game with a unique Martian setting. We also considered the game design, controls, difficulty, and player experience.
